needsReview.element: Online-only badge on the product page
needsReview.note: The public product answer (GET /public/product/:locale/:slug) sends is_rx and available_online but not online_exclusive (available_online means shipped online, not online only), so the page cannot show the badge.

needsReview.element: Online-only note on a card and in search results
needsReview.note: The public card answers (category items and product search) send is_rx but no online_exclusive; add it next to is_rx in the card DTOs.

needsReview.element: Old price and discount sent for a prescription item
needsReview.note: The public product DTO sends old_price, discount_percent and has_discount for an Rx item (the admin catalogue lists withhold them); the client hides them with canShowPromo, the DTO should too.

needsReview.element: Online-only chip on a wishlist row
needsReview.note: GET /users/me/wishlist sends requires_prescription but not online_exclusive.

needsReview.element: Needs-a-prescription and online-only on a medicine result
needsReview.note: GET /home/search medicine rows carry id, names, price only: no requires_prescription or online_exclusive.

needsReview.element: Online-only note on a cart line
needsReview.note: Fixed on design/rx-rules: stored on the line when added. Web add paths that cannot know it: the public product page, the product cards and the reorder picker (their answers do not send online_exclusive); the barcode and compare pages know it but have no add-to-cart.

needsReview.element: Suggested specialty needs the admin mapping
